text: In October 2022, Abu Dhabi's Supreme Council for Financial and Economic Affairs transferred full ownership of Etihad Aviation Group, the parent of Etihad Airways, from the Abu Dhabi government to ADQ, an Abu Dhabi investment and holding company.

source.name: Abu Dhabi Media Office: Etihad Aviation Group Transferred to ADQ’s Portfolio
source.quote: The Supreme Council for Financial and Economic Affairs has transferred full ownership of Etihad Aviation Group (EAG) to ADQ, an Abu Dhabi-based investment and holding company.

additionalSources.name: ch-aviation: Etihad joins Abu Dhabi’s consolidated L'imad investment fund
additionalSources.quote: parent of Etihad Airways, was directly owned by the Abu Dhabi government until October 2022, when SCFEA transferred its full ownership to ADQ, alongside Abu Dhabi Airports and Etihad Rail.
